purpose: Make the future session’s office legible and uncramped after the foundation audit.
rule: Read telos and factor map before choosing a frontier.

cards.title: Start with the telos, not the latest pilot.
cards.instruction: Ask what capability the next turn is trying to earn.

cards.title: Separate permanent constraints from phase-bound gates.
cards.instruction: Do not inherit no-people/no-DOJ/no-status as theology.

cards.title: Use the factor map before editing ledgers.
cards.instruction: Know the module you are touching.

cards.title: Read audit findings and debts.
cards.instruction: Do not add new surfaces where a consolidation surface is already due.

cards.title: Choose exactly one route for the next revision.
cards.instruction: Name the route and why it is safe.

cards.title: Keep no-live-data counters explicit.
cards.instruction: If opening any live data lane, add an earned capability receipt first.

cards.title: When in doubt, add a receipt, not a claim.
cards.instruction: Receipts preserve options; premature claims narrow them.

cards.title: Remember the seed’s breadth.
cards.instruction: Wandering, settlements, Brady/Giglio, union contracts, FOIA, families, and small agencies are core, not extras.
